A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoLM research and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–F. Both have 21 pages; pages 3–21 match in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v3 reports original fine-tuning experiments and ablations in Section 5, plus Llama-60M pretraining results in Appendix F, Figure 6 and Table 9.

after.justification: v4 retains the original fine-tuning experiments, ablations and appendix pretraining results, including their numerical outcomes.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same small-source inclusion, Adam-normalized gradient matching, zeroth-order V-projection estimates and sparsification procedure.

E1.justification: Both retain MathInstruct and its six math evaluations, SST-2/CB/MultiRC classification, and the five-source Pile pretraining mixture with SQuAD/WiC/COPA evaluation. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same FT, CL, BL, GN, LC, FL and MP comparators. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the ablation, classification and pretraining experiments.

E3.justification: Training budgets, batch sizes, model configurations, LoRA settings, sampling and clustering procedures, and evaluation metrics match throughout Section 5 and Appendices C–F.

E4.justification: Tables 2–6 retain identical component, sparsification, gradient-approximation and layer ablations. Batch-size sensitivity, gradient variance, completion length, training loss and convergence analyses are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both state that experiments are repeated three times in Section 5.1 and Appendix C, and retain the same uncertainty reporting in Tables 1–7. No statistical reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results match. For example, Table 1 retains CoLM's overall accuracy of 56.6±0.9, and Table 9 retains its average downstream accuracy of 43.9 under the same respective settings.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations, Theorems 4.1–4.3, and the definitions, assumptions, lemmas and proofs in Appendix A are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and claims about small-source representation, memory savings, convergence and performance with smaller mini-batches.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning source imbalance, Adam normalization, gradient dimensionality, activation memory and clustering are unchanged. No substantive limitation or applicability qualification is added or removed.

D1.justification: The v4 abstract adds a code-availability statement and a link to the BigML-CS-UCLA/CoLM repository, absent from v3. This adds implementation access information; the existing technical disclosures are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the contextual citations and the reference list are unchanged. Neither cited-work coverage nor positioning relative to prior research is revised.

P1.justification: v4 appends one code-availability sentence to the abstract and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The added abstract line shifts the introduction and moves one line from page 1 to page 2, with minor spacing adjustments. Figures 1–6, Tables 1–9 and all page layouts from page 3 onward are unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 supplies an implementation repository location missing from v3, modestly improving reproducibility guidance. The scientific evidence and appendices remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the added access information, but do not establish the linked code's completeness or usability.
